metadata.description: Q Branch: where the gadgets for AI agents get built and proven. headjack (skills just in time), middleout (API calls, compressed), moneyball (right-sized models), groundhog (lessons that stick).

plugins.name: headjack
plugins.description: Skills, loaded the moment you need them. Two root skills + a per-prompt retrieval hook replace a preloaded skill listing: the library stays indexed and out of context until a task needs it.

plugins.name: middleout
plugins.description: API calls, compressed. Wraps this project's MCP servers so agents fetch only the fields they need: hierarchical plans, one-to-many fan-out, automatic pagination, read-only by default. A hook measures raw MCP traffic and nudges toward middleout.

plugins.name: moneyball
plugins.description: Right-size your agents on evidence: measure every subagent run's cost and success from transcripts, graduate repeatable jobs to cheaper models, and route dispatches with a hook.

plugins.name: groundhog
plugins.description: Stop re-living the same session: mine transcripts for repeated procedures and re-learned lessons, keep them in a committed ledger, and enforce them with hooks instead of longer prompts.
